title: Director at IT Services Firm Sees Constructive Teradata Cloud Migration Demand Despite Softer On-Prem Renewals
expert: Director of AI strategy partnerships at a global IT services firm (current; 10–12 active Teradata enterprise accounts)
verdict: Across 10–12 Teradata accounts, consumption is growing ~4% q/q and the software footprint 12%–15% y/y, but Q4 renewal dollars ran ~10% below Q3 and on-prem spend is falling 5%–8%, so cloud gains only partly net out.
